sources.title: City of Statesboro, Georgia: Council Minutes, Regular Meeting of August 18, 2026 (item 8, application RZ 26-07-05)
sources.attribution: City of Statesboro, Georgia, Mayor and City Council
sources.summary: Minutes of the 18 August 2026 regular council meeting. Item 8 is the public hearing on application RZ 26-07-05, in which 4AM Development, LLC requests a zoning map amendment from R-4 (High-Density Residential) to O (Office and Business District) for one 26.49-acre parcel at 6539 Burkhalter Road for a proposed data center (printed as Tax Parcel 101 000001 000). Staff report that the site, previously entitled for about 240 apartments, contains an older single-family home, lies between a solar farm and residential subdivisions under a Georgia Power transmission line, and that the applicant's conceptual plan shows an approximately 230,000 sq ft two-story facility centred on the parcel; a Special Use Permit with full public review is still required before any data center can be developed, and the Planning Commission recommended approval 5-1 on 4 August 2026. The applicant's representatives state that 4AM Development received clear title to the property and intends to comply with the city's data-center ordinance and the Special Use Permit process. A motion to deny failed 2-3 and the motion to approve passed 3-2, the mayor breaking the tie.
sources.date_semantics: The minutes record the council decision taken at the meeting of 18 August 2026, which is used as the observation date. Publication is dated 1 September 2026 from the PDF creation date (2026-09-01 16:53 UTC) and the matching upload timestamp in the document link (t=202609011258290); the minutes were posted after the meeting. Names of members of the public in the minutes are not reproduced.

sources.title: QTS Data Centers: Bessemer, Alabama data center page (Construction Update; page dateModified 2026-10-20)
sources.publisher: QTS Realty Trust, LLC (QTS Data Centers)
sources.summary: QTS's Bessemer page states that QTS is developing a data center facility in the Bessemer area. Its 'Construction Update' says that QTS and its partners have started to mobilize equipment onsite, begin clearing and earthwork operations, and start conducting pre-blast surveys; it adds that controlled blasting will be needed to excavate rock, that seismic monitors are being installed to set a baseline, and that blasting will be done by a third-party specialist. A 'Project Location' section publishes a map 'of the general area where QTS is developing a data center facility in Bessemer', centred at (33.3445330, -87.0392730) at zoom 15; its only pin is a hidden placeholder for an unrelated Colorado Springs address. The page gives no capacity, building count or opening date.
